description: Derives current controller linear and angular velocity from grip/aim pose history and can reduce VRLink's stock four controller pose sends per display frame.

options.title: Maximum linear speed (m/s)

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+44 (float32 rad/s). Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived angular speed. Allowed range: 1 to 100 rad/s.

description: Overrides the HMD identity reported to SteamVR. Recommended selects Meta Quest Pro for exact legacy bundle targets through 5002244, including 2.0.20/5001712; otherwise Galaxy XR. name: Device identity

description: Permission-free resolution fix for exact builds 5001712, 5002244, 5002296, 5002313, 5002318, and 5002322. The tested default preserves native projections and source formats, including future RGB10_A2, with a static 2x2 Android-surface quad. Optional 2.0.22/5002322 experiment replaces only the underside with a static black Surface-backed projection, keeping 3 total layers. No image copy or reconstruction. 2.0.20 remains unchanged.

options.description: On 2.0.22/5002322, the experiment replaces the underside with static black, keeping 3 projections and no extra quad. Resolution and speed are unverified. Every other build keeps the terminal quad, including 2.0.20.

If a path to a folder is provided, the folder must contain one or more of the following folders, depending on the DPI of the device:

- drawable-xxxhdpi
- drawable-xxhdpi
- drawable-xhdpi
- drawable-hdpi
- drawable-mdpi

Each of the folders must contain all of the following files:

[Generic header]

- drawable-xxxhdpi: 488px x 192px
- drawable-xxhdpi: 366px x 144px
- drawable-xhdpi: 244px x 96px
- drawable-hdpi: 184px x 72px
- drawable-mdpi: 122px x 48px

[Premium header]

- yt_premium_wordmark_header_light.png
- yt_premium_wordmark_header_dark.png

The image dimensions must be as follows:
- drawable-xxxhdpi: 516px x 192px
- drawable-xxhdpi: 387px x 144px
- drawable-xhdpi: 258px x 96px
- drawable-hdpi: 194px x 72px
- drawable-mdpi: 129px x 48px
